validity.recommendation: Do not treat P1900 as an independently verified pipeline. Escalate the whole 2022-07-19 A47-Yanbu / UBTG kilometer-post cluster (P1897, P1898, P1899, P1900, P1901, P1903, P1910, P1911, P1912) for a human de-dup/consolidation review against the Master Gas System trunk representation (P3962 East-West Gas Pipeline; GulfPub 'East-West Gas Pipeline' / 'Master Gas System 2'). P1900 is most likely a km-post model segment, not a distinct commercial pipeline.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (primary concern). The sheet's own support for P1900 is TWO generic OPEC Annual Statistics Bulletin references (ASB2012 p.75 and ASB2013 p.79) attached on the gem.wiki page. Those pages are Saudi Arabia country gas production/reserve statistical tables; neither names this pipeline, 'UBTG', 'AY-1', 'A47-Yanbu', or a KP916 kilometer post. So the only support is a generic citation that does not name the pipeline -> textbook existence flag. Independent web + trade-press searches (Aramco, Fluor, MEED, OGN, general) return ZERO independent uses of the designations 'UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916', 'AY-1 KP916', or the 'A47-Yanbu gas pipeline' as a named line -- every hit for these exact tokens traces back to gem.wiki. The A47-Yanbu / Master Gas System gas corridor to Yanbu genuinely exists (corroborated: OGN 'Stepping on the gas' names the Master Gas System reaching Yanbu; Fluor documents the Saudi Aramco Gas Program EPC), so the underlying physical trunk is real -- but that corroborates a TRUNK, not this km-post micro-segment. The name itself ('UBTG km56' -> 'AY-1 KP916') is a pair of engineering reference points (UBTG trunk at km 56; A47-Yanbu line at kilometer post 916), i.e. a network-model segment label, not a commercially named pipeline. DUPLICATE/SEGMENTATION (secondary): P1900 is one of ~9-13 rows bulk-imported the same day (2022-07-19) that decompose the A47-Yanbu (AY-1) / UBTG / Master Gas System corridor into km-post segments -- P1897 'A47-Yanbu' (966 km, the parent line), P1903 'AY-1 KP943-Riyadh' (153 km), P1898/P1899 'UBTG-1-Berri' (249/247 km, dia 56,36,38,40,42 -- note P1900 shares 56 in and ~244-249 km), P1910/P1911 'UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56', P1912 'Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0'. GulfPub's independent Saudi Arabia gas roster (SA is its best-covered country, 20 features) contains NO UBTG/AY-1 segments at all -- it represents this network only as single trunk lines ('East-West Gas Pipeline' Abqaiq/Shedgum->Yanbu 727 km; 'Master Gas System 2' Riyadh->Yanbu 924 km). GEM already carries P3962 'East-West Gas Pipeline / Main Line' (Eastern Province->Yanbu, 1200 km) as the trunk. The km-post cluster therefore double-counts the same physical corridor at segment granularity. CLASSIFICATION: if it exists at all it is a gas transmission trunk segment (fuel=Gas OK, gas tracker OK) -- no oil/NGL/plant-internal misclassification found. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/Operator=Saudi Aramco is plausible (Aramco owns/operates the Master Gas System) and consistent with GulfPub op=Aramco for the corridor. SPEC: length 244 km (sheet) vs 245 km (wiki) trivial; diameter 56 in and length are unverifiable against any independent source at segment level. Bottom line: real corridor, but P1900 as a discrete named pipeline is unverified and probably a model/segment artifact double-counting the MGS trunk.

routes.corridor_desc: Cannot be resolved at segment level without fabrication. The named endpoints ('UBTG km56' and 'AY-1 KP916') are internal kilometer-post references, not geolocatable public places, and no independent source maps them. All that can be defended: P1900 lies within the Saudi Aramco Master Gas System / A47-Yanbu gas corridor, which runs west from the Eastern Province gas hubs (Uthmaniyah / Shedgum / Berri, ~25-26N 49-50E) across the peninsula toward Yanbu on the Red Sea (~24.1N 38.1E). A 244 km segment tied to AY-1 KP916 (near the western/Yanbu end of the 966 km A47-Yanbu line) is internally incoherent with a 56 km 'km56' eastern reference, further suggesting a model artifact rather than a literal contiguous pipe. Coordinates given are broad regional corridor anchors only; the true endpoints are unknown. NO coordinates fabricated for the actual termini (left null).
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints could not be established as named facilities from any independent source; the row's designations are engineering km-posts. Corridor bounded only at the Master Gas System (Eastern Province -> Yanbu) level, corroborated by OGN. Uthmaniyah and Yanbu coordinates are real named-place regional anchors flagged explicitly as corridor bounds, not the segment's termini. True endpoint lat/lon left null to avoid fabrication.

summary: P1900 CONCERN (existence + duplicate/segmentation): only support is generic OPEC statistical tables that don't name it; no independent source uses 'UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916'; one of a 2022-07-19 km-post cluster double-counting the A47-Yanbu/Master Gas System trunk (P3962; GulfPub has no such segments). Corridor only resolvable to MGS Eastern Province->Yanbu (route accuracy low); true endpoints unresolved.
